appearance.kindLabelsHint: On the type filters and on every preview.
appearance.thumbSizeHint: Card size in the grid. The slider above the grid changes it too.
appearance.pixelatedHint: Enlarge images with sharp pixels instead of smoothing them.

updates.checkOnLaunchHint: Looks quietly a few seconds after start. Nothing installs without asking.

ai.intro: Ask and Suggest tags run on Claude with your own Anthropic API key, billed to your API account.
ai.keySet: Set. Kept in your system's credential store, never in the library.
ai.removeHint: Ask stops working until you add a key again.
ai.sent: What Ask sends to Anthropic: the words you type, Mimikit's search syntax and your tag names. Never file names, folder paths, file contents or thumbnails.
ai.modelHint: Haiku is fastest and cheapest. Sonnet and Opus cost about 20 and 40 times as much.
ai.effortHint: Higher is slower and costs more. Low is enough for searches.

about.supportHint: It's free. Tips keep it going.

ignored.title: Ignored folders
ignored.hint: Skipped in every library folder, like hidden folders and node_modules.
ignored.placeholder: Folder name, like Backup or _old, then Enter
ignored.invalid: Enter one folder name, not a path.
ignored.saved: Saved. Rescan to apply it to files already in the library.
ignored.pending: Changes apply on the next rescan. Files stay on disk.

analysis.progress_other: <0>{{done}}</0> of <0>{{count}}</0> images analysed for Find similar and search by colour.

analysis.keepHint: While Mimikit is open. Turns on by itself after the first full analysis.

backups.restoreHint: It replaces your library: folders, tags, ratings, notes, collections and sprite grids. The current library is saved in the backups folder first. Mimikit restarts to finish.
backups.libraryHint: Folders, tags, ratings, notes, collections and sprite grids. Your asset files aren't included.
backups.autoHint: One a day when Mimikit opens. The last 5 are kept.
